-- STEAL AN EGG TYCOON V2 — HUD CLIENTE
-- Instalar em StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts como LocalScript.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local event=ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EggTycoonV2_Toast")
local playerGui=player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name="EggTycoonV2_HUD"
gui.ResetOnSpawn=false
gui.DisplayOrder=2
gui.IgnoreGuiInset=false
gui.Parent=playerGui
local function rect(parent, size, pos, color)
 local f=Instance.new("Frame") f.Size=size f.Position=pos f.BackgroundColor3=color f.BorderSizePixel=0 f.Parent=parent
 local corner=Instance.new("UICorner") corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,5) corner.Parent=f
 return f
end
local function text(parent,size,pos,initial,col,fontsize,bold)
 local t=Instance.new("TextLabel") t.Size=size t.Position=pos
 t.BackgroundTransparency=1 t.Text=initial
 t.Font=bold and Enum.Font.ArialBold or Enum.Font.Arial
 t.TextColor3=col or Color3.fromRGB(248,248,251)
 t.TextSize=fontsize or 17 t.TextWrapped=true
 t.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
 t.Parent=parent
 return t
end
local panel=rect(gui,UDim2.fromOffset(290,160),UDim2.new(1,-306,0,22),Color3.fromRGB(57,78,65))
panel.BackgroundTransparency=.07
local stroke=Instance.new("UIStroke") stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(230,208,120) stroke.Thickness=1.7 stroke.Parent=panel
text(panel,UDim2.new(1,-25,0,30),UDim2.fromOffset(13,7),"🥚 STEAL AN EGG TYCOON",Color3.fromRGB(250,230,148),17,true)
local cash=text(panel,UDim2.new(1,-25,0,24),UDim2.fromOffset(13,40),"💵 CASH: $0",Color3.fromRGB(255,218,113),19,true)
local earn=text(panel,UDim2.new(1,-25,0,23),UDim2.fromOffset(13,66),"⚡ PRODUCAO: $0/s",Color3.fromRGB(189,238,170),16,true)
local carry=text(panel,UDim2.new(1,-25,0,21),UDim2.fromOffset(13,91),"🥚 CARREGANDO: NADA",Color3.fromRGB(245,239,229),14,true)
local shield=text(panel,UDim2.new(1,-25,0,21),UDim2.fromOffset(13,114),"🛡️ ESCUDO: 0s",Color3.fromRGB(161,202,255),14,true)
local base=text(panel,UDim2.new(1,-25,0,20),UDim2.fromOffset(13,135),"🏠 BASE: ?",Color3.fromRGB(204,212,230),13,true)
local tip=rect(gui,UDim2.fromOffset(410,68),UDim2.new(.5,-205,1,-90),Color3.fromRGB(57,78,65))
tip.BackgroundTransparency=.08
local msg=text(tip,UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-10),UDim2.fromOffset(12,5),"Roube um ovo no corredor, volte ao tycoon e incube!",Color3.fromRGB(242,244,255),16,true)
msg.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
msg.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
local lastToast=0
local function shorten(n)
 n=tonumber(n) or 0
 if n>=1e9 then return string.format("%.1fB",n/1e9) end
 if n>=1e6 then return string.format("%.1fM",n/1e6) end
 if n>=1e3 then return string.format("%.1fK",n/1e3) end
 return tostring(math.floor(n))
end
local function refresh()
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
 local value=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Cash")
 cash.Text="💵 CASH: $"..shorten(value and value.Value or 0)
 earn.Text="⚡ PRODUCAO: $"..shorten(player:GetAttribute("EggIncome") or 0).."/s"
 carry.Text="🥚 CARREGANDO: "..tostring(player:GetAttribute("EggCarrying") or "NADA")
 shield.Text="🛡️ ESCUDO: "..tostring(player:GetAttribute("EggShield") or 0).."s"
 base.Text="🏠 TYCOON #"..tostring(player:GetAttribute("EggBase") or "?").." • REBIRTH: "..tostring(stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Rebirths") and stats.Rebirths.Value or 0)
end
for _,attr in ipairs({"EggIncome","EggCarrying","EggShield","EggBase"}) do
 player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attr):Connect(refresh)
end
local stats=player:WaitForChild("leaderstats")
stats:WaitForChild("Cash"):GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(refresh)
stats:WaitForChild("Rebirths"):GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(refresh)
event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(message)
 lastToast+=1
 local mine=lastToast
 msg.Text=tostring(message)
 task.delay(6,function()
  if mine==lastToast then msg.Text="EXPEDICAO → ROUBAR → BASE → INCUBADORA" end
 end)
end)
refresh()

-- STEAL AN EGG TYCOON V2 — SCRIPT DE SERVIDOR
-- Instalar em ServerScriptService como Script (nao LocalScript).
-- Prototipo intencionalmente sem DataStore: progresso reinicia em cada Play.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace=game:GetService("Workspace")
local ProximityPromptService=game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROOT=Workspace:WaitForChild("StealAnEggTycoon_V2")
local BASES=ROOT:WaitForChild("Tycoons")
local NESTS=ROOT:WaitForChild("Ninhos")
local GUARDS=ROOT:WaitForChild("Guardioes")
local BELL=Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
BELL.Name="EggTycoonV2_Toast"
BELL.Parent=ReplicatedStorage

local CONFIG={
 StartWalkSpeed=20,
 RebirthCost=150000,
 RobberyThreshold=20000, -- renda total ganha: liberar invasoes a BASE dos ricos
 MaxSlots=8,
 MaxSprintLevel=5,
 ShieldCost=1250,
 ShieldTime=40,
 ShieldCooldown=110,
 NewPlayerShield=90,
 PostRobberyShield=35,
 RaidThreshold=30000,  -- NPCs podem atacar apos $30K ganhos ou 1 rebirth
 RaidCooldown=180,    -- segundos entre tentativas de invasao
}
local species={
 {Name="Pintinho",Rate=8,Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,218,84),Hatch=7},
 {Name="Coruja Folha",Rate=22,Color=Color3.fromRGB(128,232,135),Hatch=8},
 {Name="Sapo Mutante",Rate=55,Color=Color3.fromRGB(168,243,78),Hatch=9},
 {Name="Raptor Fossil",Rate=125,Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,166,91),Hatch=10},
 {Name="Pinguim Cristal",Rate=300,Color=Color3.fromRGB(115,219,255),Hatch=11},
 {Name="Dragao de Brasa",Rate=700,Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,112,66),Hatch=13},
 {Name="Fenix do Vazio",Rate=1600,Color=Color3.fromRGB(220,111,255),Hatch=15},
}
local sessions={}
local guardians={}
local raids={}
local raidersFolder=Instance.new("Folder") raidersFolder.Name="InvasoresNPC" raidersFolder.Parent=ROOT

local function toast(player,msg)
 if player and player.Parent==Players then BELL:FireClient(player,tostring(msg)) end
end
local function fmt(n)
 n=math.floor(n)
 if n>=1000000 then return string.format("%.1fM",n/1000000) end
 if n>=1000 then return string.format("%.1fK",n/1000) end
 return tostring(n)
end
local function goodChar(player)
 local c=player.Character
 local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local r=c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not (c and h and r and h.Health>0) then return nil,nil,nil end
 return c,h,r
end
local function near(player,part,limit)
 local _,h,r=goodChar(player)
 return r and part and (r.Position-part.Position).Magnitude<=(limit or 14)
end
local function world(base,x,y,z)
 return CFrame.new(base:GetAttribute("CenterX"),0,base:GetAttribute("CenterZ"))
  *CFrame.Angles(0,base:GetAttribute("Angle") or 0,0)*CFrame.new(x,y,z)
end
local function baseID(base)
 return base and base:GetAttribute("BaseId") or 0
end
local function ownBase(player,id)
 local s=sessions[player.UserId]
 return s and s.Base and baseID(s.Base)==id,s
end
local function ownerFromBase(base)
 return base and sessions[base:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") or 0]
end
local function freeSlot(state)
 if not state then return nil end
 for n=1,CONFIG.MaxSlots do if state.Creatures[n]==nil then return n end end
 return nil
end
local function countCreatures(state)
 local n=0
 for _,c in pairs(state.Creatures) do if c then n+=1 end end
 return n
end
local function income(state)
 local sum=0
 for _,c in pairs(state.Creatures) do if c then sum+=c.Rate end end
 return math.floor(sum*(1+state.Rebirths*.25))
end
local function syncState(state)
 local player=state.Player
 if not player or player.Parent~=Players then return end
 state.Cash=math.max(0,math.floor(state.Cash))
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
 if stats then
  local c=stats:FindFirstChild("Cash")
  local r=stats:FindFirstChild("Rebirths")
  if c then c.Value=state.Cash end
  if r then r.Value=state.Rebirths end
 end
 player:SetAttribute("EggIncome",income(state))
 player:SetAttribute("EggCarrying",state.Held and (state.Held.Kind=="Egg" and ("OVO: "..species[state.Held.Biome].Name) or ("CRIATURA: "..state.Held.Creature.Name)) or "NADA")
 player:SetAttribute("EggBase",state.Base and tostring(baseID(state.Base)) or "SEM BASE")
 player:SetAttribute("EggTotal",state.TotalEarned)
 player:SetAttribute("EggPvP",state.TotalEarned>=CONFIG.RobberyThreshold or state.Rebirths>=1)
 if state.Base then
  player:SetAttribute("EggShield",math.max(0,math.ceil(state.ShieldUntil-os.clock())))
 end
end
local function setSign(base,line)
 local sign=base and base:FindFirstChild("PlacaDoDono",true)
 local gui=sign and sign:FindFirstChild("MapLabel")
 local title=gui and gui:FindFirstChild("Title",true)
 local sub=gui and gui:FindFirstChild("Subtitle",true)
 if sub then sub.Text=line end
 if title then title.Text=string.format("EGG TYCOON %02d",baseID(base)) end
end
local function applyWalkSpeed(s)
 local _,hum=goodChar(s.Player)
 if hum then hum.WalkSpeed=CONFIG.StartWalkSpeed+s.SpeedLevel*3+math.min(5,s.Rebirths) end
end
local function tinyPart(parent,name,size,cf,color,mat,shape)
 local part=Instance.new("Part")
 part.Name=name part.Size=size part.CFrame=cf
 part.Color=color part.Material=mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 part.Anchored=true part.CanCollide=false part.TopSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
 part.BottomSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
 if shape then part.Shape=shape end
 part.Parent=parent
 return part
end
local function buildCreature(state, slot, creature)
 if not state.Base then return end
 local base=state.Base
 local x=-48+((slot-1)%4)*32
 local z=-12+math.floor((slot-1)/4)*31
 local ground=world(base,x,4.8,z)
 local model=Instance.new("Model") model.Name="Criatura_"..slot.."_"..creature.Name model.Parent=base:WaitForChild("Criaturas")
 model:SetAttribute("Slot",slot)
 local col=creature.Color
 local body=tinyPart(model,"Body",Vector3.new(9,8,7),ground,col,Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,Enum.PartType.Ball)
 model.PrimaryPart=body
 tinyPart(model,"Head",Vector3.new(6,6,6),ground*CFrame.new(0,5,-2),col,Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,Enum.PartType.Ball)
 for side=-1,1,2 do
  tinyPart(model,"Eye",Vector3.new(1.5,1.8,.8),ground*CFrame.new(side*1.6,5.7,-4.85),Color3.new(1,1,1),Enum.Material.Neon,Enum.PartType.Ball)
  tinyPart(model,"Pupil",Vector3.new(.6,.9,.45),ground*CFrame.new(side*1.6,5.6,-5.35),Color3.fromRGB(22,32,48),Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,Enum.PartType.Ball)
  tinyPart(model,"Wing",Vector3.new(4,2,4),ground*CFrame.new(side*5,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,side*.2),col)
 end
 local beak=tinyPart(model,"Beak",Vector3.new(2.2,1.4,2.1),ground*CFrame.new(0,3.5,-5.3),Color3.fromRGB(255,182,77))
 local baseGlow=tinyPart(model,"ExtractedEssence",Vector3.new(3,3,3),ground*CFrame.new(0,-.6,3.4),Color3.fromRGB(255,249,156),Enum.Material.Neon,Enum.PartType.Ball)
 local l=Instance.new("PointLight") l.Range=13 l.Brightness=.5 l.Color=col l.Parent=baseGlow
 local sign=Instance.new("BillboardGui") sign.Name="CreatureLabel" sign.Adornee=body
 sign.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(190,58) sign.StudsOffsetWorldSpace=Vector3.new(0,10,0)
 sign.MaxDistance=60 sign.Parent=body
 local tx=Instance.new("TextLabel") tx.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,29,42)
 tx.BackgroundTransparency=.10 tx.TextColor3=col
 tx.TextStrokeTransparency=.5 tx.TextScaled=true tx.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
 tx.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
 tx.Text=creature.Name.."\n+$"..fmt(creature.Rate).."/s" tx.Parent=sign
 local corner=Instance.new("UICorner") corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,9) corner.Parent=tx
 local steal=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
 steal.Name="StealCreature" steal.ActionText="Roubar criatura" steal.ObjectText=creature.Name
 steal.HoldDuration=1.6 steal.MaxActivationDistance=11 steal.RequiresLineOfSight=false
 steal:SetAttribute("Action","StealCreature") steal:SetAttribute("BaseId",baseID(base))
 steal:SetAttribute("Slot",slot)
 steal.Parent=body
 creature.Visual=model
 return model
end
local function addCreature(state, creature, preferredSlot)
 local slot=(preferredSlot and not state.Creatures[preferredSlot]) and preferredSlot or freeSlot(state)
 if not slot then return false end
 state.Creatures[slot]=creature
 buildCreature(state,slot,creature)
 syncState(state)
 return true
end
local function removeCreature(state,slot)
 local c=state.Creatures[slot]
 if c then
  if c.Visual then c.Visual:Destroy() c.Visual=nil end
  state.Creatures[slot]=nil
  syncState(state)
 end
 return c
end
local function clearCreatures(state)
 state.Generation+=1
 for slot=1,CONFIG.MaxSlots do removeCreature(state,slot) end
 state.Pending=0
end
local function clearCarriedVisual(player)
 local char=player.Character
 local old=char and char:FindFirstChild("CarriedEggOrCreature")
 if old then old:Destroy() end
end
local function showCarried(player,s)
 clearCarriedVisual(player)
 if not s.Held then return end
 local char,hum,root=goodChar(player)
 if not root then return end
 local holder=Instance.new("Model") holder.Name="CarriedEggOrCreature" holder.Parent=char
 local b=s.Held.Biome or s.Held.Creature.Biome
 local color=species[b].Color
 local egg=Instance.new("Part") egg.Name="LootVisual" egg.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
 egg.Size=Vector3.new(4.1,5.4,4.1)
 egg.Color=color egg.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
 egg.CanCollide=false egg.CanTouch=false egg.Massless=true
 egg.CFrame=root.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,1,-3)
 egg.Parent=holder
 local weld=Instance.new("WeldConstraint") weld.Part0=root weld.Part1=egg weld.Parent=egg
 local shiny=Instance.new("PointLight") shiny.Color=color shiny.Range=12 shiny.Brightness=.7 shiny.Parent=egg
end
local function restoreStolen(held)
 if not held or held.Kind~="Creature" then return end
 local victim=sessions[held.VictimUserId]
 if victim and victim.Base and victim.SessionID==held.VictimSession and victim.Generation==held.VictimGeneration then
  if addCreature(victim,held.Creature,held.VictimSlot) then
   toast(victim.Player,"Sua criatura voltou: o ladrao nao conseguiu escapar!")
  end
 end
end
local function loseCarried(state)
 if state.Held then
  restoreStolen(state.Held)
  state.Held=nil
  clearCarriedVisual(state.Player)
  syncState(state)
 end
end
local function claimBase(state)
 local sorted=BASES:GetChildren()
 table.sort(sorted,function(a,b) return baseID(a)<baseID(b) end)
 for _,base in ipairs(sorted) do
  if base:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")==0 then
   base:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId",state.Player.UserId)
   base:SetAttribute("OwnerName",state.Player.DisplayName)
   state.Base=base
   state.ShieldUntil=os.clock()+CONFIG.NewPlayerShield
   setSign(base,state.Player.DisplayName.." • PROTEGIDO")
   syncState(state)
   return
  end
 end
 toast(state.Player,"Servidor cheio: 8 bases ocupadas.")
end
local function teleportPlayer(player,location)
 local char,hum,root=goodChar(player)
 if not root then return end
 char:PivotTo(location)
 root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
end
local function sendHome(player,s)
 if not s.Base then toast(player,"Voce ainda nao tem tycoon.") return end
 teleportPlayer(player,world(s.Base,0,7,-38))
end
local function playerJoined(player)
 local stats=Instance.new("Folder") stats.Name="leaderstats" stats.Parent=player
 local cash=Instance.new("IntValue") cash.Name="Cash" cash.Parent=stats
 local rebirth=Instance.new("IntValue") rebirth.Name="Rebirths" rebirth.Parent=stats
 local state={Player=player,Base=nil,Cash=0,TotalEarned=0,Rebirths=0,SpeedLevel=0,
  Creatures={},Pending=0,Held=nil,ShieldUntil=0,ShieldCooldownUntil=0,SessionID=os.clock(),Generation=0,NextRaidAt=os.clock()+180}
 sessions[player.UserId]=state
 claimBase(state)
 syncState(state)
 local function charReady(char)
  task.wait(.3)
  if sessions[player.UserId]~=state then return end
  local humanoid=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if humanoid then
   humanoid.WalkSpeed=CONFIG.StartWalkSpeed+state.SpeedLevel*3+math.min(5,state.Rebirths)
   humanoid.Died:Connect(function() loseCarried(state) end)
  end
  if state.Base then teleportPlayer(player,world(state.Base,0,8,-38)) end
 end
 player.CharacterAdded:Connect(charReady)
 if player.Character then task.spawn(charReady,player.Character) end
 task.delay(3,function()
  if sessions[player.UserId]==state then
   toast(player,"Boas-vindas! Use EXPEDICAO para roubar um ovo. Depois, INCUBADORA!")
  end
 end)
end
local function playerLeft(player)
 local raid=raids[player.UserId]
 if raid then
  if raid.Model then raid.Model:Destroy() end
  raids[player.UserId]=nil
 end
 local s=sessions[player.UserId]
 if not s then return end
 loseCarried(s)
 clearCreatures(s)
 if s.Base then
  s.Base:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId",0)
  s.Base:SetAttribute("OwnerName","LIVRE")
  setSign(s.Base,"BASE DISPONIVEL")
 end
 sessions[player.UserId]=nil
end

local function pickupEgg(player,s,egg,promptObj)
 if s.Held then toast(player,"Primeiro entregue o que ja esta carregando!") return end
 local nest=egg.Parent
 if not nest or not nest:IsA("Model") then return end
 if not nest:GetAttribute("Available") then return end
 local b=nest:GetAttribute("Biome")
 if not species[b] then return end
 if not near(player,egg,12) then return end
 nest:SetAttribute("Available",false)
 promptObj.Enabled=false
 egg.Transparency=1
 s.Held={Kind="Egg",Biome=b}
 showCarried(player,s)
 syncState(s)
 toast(player,"OVO ROUBADO: "..species[b].Name.."! Fuja dos guardioes e volte ao tycoon!")
 local cooldown=nest:GetAttribute("RespawnSeconds") or 20
 task.delay(cooldown,function()
  if not nest.Parent then return end
  nest:SetAttribute("Available",true)
  egg.Transparency=0
  promptObj.Enabled=true
 end)
end
local function deliverEgg(player,s)
 if not s.Held then toast(player,"Roube um ovo na expedicao primeiro!") return end
 if s.Held.Kind=="Creature" then
  local held=s.Held
  if not freeSlot(s) then toast(player,"Todos os 8 habitats estao ocupados.") return end
  local wasAdded=addCreature(s,held.Creature)
  if wasAdded then
   s.Held=nil
   clearCarriedVisual(player)
   syncState(s)
   toast(player,"Criatura roubada instalada no seu tycoon: +$"..held.Creature.Rate.."/s!")
  end
  return
 end
 if countCreatures(s)+s.Pending>=CONFIG.MaxSlots then
  toast(player,"Habitats cheios! Sao 8 slots por base neste prototipo.")
  return
 end
 local b=s.Held.Biome
 s.Held=nil
 clearCarriedVisual(player)
 s.Pending+=1
 syncState(s)
 toast(player,"Ovo incubando: "..species[b].Name.." ("..species[b].Hatch.." segundos)!")
 local userId=player.UserId
 local reference=s.SessionID
 local generation=s.Generation
 task.delay(species[b].Hatch,function()
  local current=sessions[userId]
  if current~=s or current.SessionID~=reference or current.Generation~=generation then return end
  current.Pending=math.max(0,current.Pending-1)
  local kind=species[b]
  local creature={Name=kind.Name,Biome=b,Rate=kind.Rate,Color=kind.Color}
  if addCreature(current,creature) then
   toast(current.Player,"NASCEU: "..kind.Name.."! Agora produz $"..kind.Rate.." por segundo.")
  end
 end)
end
local function tryStealCreature(player,s,part,pr)
 if s.Held then toast(player,"Voce so pode carregar uma coisa por vez!") return end
 if countCreatures(s)+s.Pending>=CONFIG.MaxSlots then toast(player,"Voce precisa de um habitat livre antes de roubar!") return end
 local from=BASES:FindFirstChild(string.format("Tycoon_%02d",pr:GetAttribute("BaseId") or 0))
 if not from then return end
 if from==s.Base then toast(player,"Essa criatura ja e sua!") return end
 local victim=ownerFromBase(from)
 if not victim then return end
 if victim.ShieldUntil>os.clock() then
  toast(player,"Esse tycoon ainda esta protegido por escudo!") return
 end
 if victim.TotalEarned<CONFIG.RobberyThreshold and victim.Rebirths<1 then
  toast(player,"Tycoon iniciante protegido! Roubo desbloqueado aos $20K ganhos ou 1 Rebirth.")
  return
 end
 local slot=pr:GetAttribute("Slot")
 if typeof(slot)~="number" or not victim.Creatures[slot] then return end
 if not near(player,part,12) then return end
 local stolen=removeCreature(victim,slot)
 if not stolen then return end
 s.Held={Kind="Creature",Creature=stolen,VictimUserId=victim.Player.UserId,
  VictimSession=victim.SessionID,VictimGeneration=victim.Generation,VictimSlot=slot,Biome=stolen.Biome}
 victim.ShieldUntil=os.clock()+CONFIG.PostRobberyShield
 setSign(from,victim.Player.DisplayName.." • ESCUDO ATIVO")
 showCarried(player,s)
 syncState(s) syncState(victim)
 toast(player,"ROUBOU "..stolen.Name.."! Corra para SUA incubadora!")
 toast(victim.Player,"ALERTA: roubaram "..stolen.Name.."! Protecao temporaria ativada.")
end
local function buySprint(player,s)
 if s.SpeedLevel>=CONFIG.MaxSprintLevel then toast(player,"Sua velocidade ja esta no maximo!") return end
 local price=500*(3^s.SpeedLevel)
 if s.Cash<price then toast(player,"Sprint custa $"..fmt(price).." (voce tem $"..fmt(s.Cash)..")") return end
 s.Cash-=price s.SpeedLevel+=1
 applyWalkSpeed(s) syncState(s)
 toast(player,"Velocidade melhorada para "..(CONFIG.StartWalkSpeed+s.SpeedLevel*3+math.min(5,s.Rebirths)).."!")
end
local function buyShield(player,s)
 local now=os.clock()
 if s.ShieldCooldownUntil>now then
  toast(player,"Escudo em cooldown: "..math.ceil(s.ShieldCooldownUntil-now).."s.") return
 end
 if s.Cash<CONFIG.ShieldCost then toast(player,"Escudo custa $"..CONFIG.ShieldCost..".") return end
 s.Cash-=CONFIG.ShieldCost
 s.ShieldUntil=math.max(s.ShieldUntil,now)+CONFIG.ShieldTime
 s.ShieldCooldownUntil=now+CONFIG.ShieldCooldown
 syncState(s)
 toast(player,"ESCUDO ATIVADO! Criaturas protegidas por mais 40 segundos.")
end
local function doRebirth(player,s)
 if s.Cash<CONFIG.RebirthCost then
  toast(player,"Rebirth exige $"..fmt(CONFIG.RebirthCost).." em dinheiro disponivel.") return
 end
 if s.Held then toast(player,"Entregue seu ovo antes de fazer Rebirth!") return end
 if raids[player.UserId] then toast(player,"Resolva a invasao NPC antes do Rebirth!") return end
 s.Cash=0
 clearCreatures(s)
 s.Rebirths+=1
 s.SpeedLevel=0
 s.ShieldUntil=os.clock()+CONFIG.NewPlayerShield
 applyWalkSpeed(s) syncState(s)
 toast(player,"REBIRTH "..s.Rebirths.."! +25% de renda/rebirth. Sua base foi reiniciada.")
end

-- EVENTOS PVE: invasores NPC tentam sequestrar criaturas de tycoons avancados.
-- O dono pode APERTAR E no NPC para afasta-lo, inclusive durante a fuga.
local function raidSpot(base,slot)
 local x=-48+((slot-1)%4)*32
 local z=-12+math.floor((slot-1)/4)*31
 return world(base,x,5.2,z).Position
end
local function endRaid(state,restore,message)
 if not state then return end
 local raid=raids[state.Player.UserId]
 if not raid then return end
 raids[state.Player.UserId]=nil
 if restore and raid.Stolen then addCreature(state,raid.Stolen,raid.Slot) end
 if raid.Model then raid.Model:Destroy() end
 state.NextRaidAt=os.clock()+CONFIG.RaidCooldown
 if message then toast(state.Player,message) end
end
local function startRaid(state)
 if not state.Base or countCreatures(state)==0 then return end
 local candidate={}
 for slot,c in pairs(state.Creatures) do if c then table.insert(candidate,slot) end end
 if #candidate==0 then return end
 local slot=candidate[math.random(1,#candidate)]
 local base=state.Base
 local pos=world(base,0,6,-94).Position
 local m=Instance.new("Model") m.Name="Ladrao_NPC_Base_"..baseID(base) m.Parent=raidersFolder
 local core=tinyPart(m,"CorpoInvasor",Vector3.new(7,9,6),CFrame.new(pos),Color3.fromRGB(241,91,105),Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,Enum.PartType.Ball)
 m.PrimaryPart=core
 tinyPart(m,"Cabeca",Vector3.new(6,6,6),CFrame.new(pos+Vector3.new(0,6,0)),Color3.fromRGB(198,64,84),Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,Enum.PartType.Ball)
 for side=-1,1,2 do
  tinyPart(m,"Olho",Vector3.new(1,1.7,.7),CFrame.new(pos+Vector3.new(side*1.4,7,-3)),Color3.new(1,1,1),Enum.Material.Neon,Enum.PartType.Ball)
 end
 local catch=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
 catch.Name="PararInvasor" catch.ActionText="AFUGENTAR LADRAO" catch.ObjectText="Invasor NPC"
 catch.HoldDuration=.9 catch.MaxActivationDistance=10 catch.RequiresLineOfSight=false
 catch:SetAttribute("Action","RepelRaid") catch:SetAttribute("BaseId",baseID(base))
 catch.Parent=core
 local bell=Instance.new("BillboardGui") bell.Adornee=core bell.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(200,55)
 bell.StudsOffsetWorldSpace=Vector3.new(0,12,0) bell.MaxDistance=95 bell.Parent=core
 local txt=Instance.new("TextLabel") txt.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
 txt.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(94,17,35) txt.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
 txt.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold txt.TextScaled=true txt.Text="INVASOR NPC!\nAPERTE E!" txt.Parent=bell
 local raid={Model=m,Part=core,Position=pos,Slot=slot,State="Approach",Stolen=nil,
  Target=raidSpot(base,slot),Exit=world(base,0,6,-105).Position,Started=os.clock()}
 raids[state.Player.UserId]=raid
 toast(state.Player,"ALERTA VERMELHO: INVASOR NPC NA BASE! Ache o ladrao vermelho e aperte E!")
end
local function stepRaids(dt,now)
 for uid,raid in pairs(raids) do
  local state=sessions[uid]
  if not state or not state.Base then
   if raid.Model then raid.Model:Destroy() end
   raids[uid]=nil
  elseif state.ShieldUntil>now then
   endRaid(state,true,"O escudo expulsou o invasor NPC!")
  elseif raid.Model and raid.Model.Parent then
   local goal=raid.State=="Approach" and raid.Target or raid.Exit
   local step=Vector3.new(goal.X-raid.Position.X,0,goal.Z-raid.Position.Z)
   local mag=step.Magnitude
   if mag>0.2 then
    local speed=raid.State=="Approach" and 7 or 10
    local dist=math.min(mag,speed*dt)
    raid.Position=raid.Position+step.Unit*dist
    raid.Model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(raid.Position,Vector3.new(goal.X,raid.Position.Y,goal.Z)))
   end
   if mag<3.5 then
    if raid.State=="Approach" then
     raid.Stolen=removeCreature(state,raid.Slot)
     raid.State="Flee"
     toast(state.Player,"O invasor pegou uma criatura! Alcance-o e aperte E antes da fuga!")
    else
     endRaid(state,false,raid.Stolen and ("O invasor fugiu com "..raid.Stolen.Name.."!") or "Invasor foi embora.")
    end
   end
  end
 end
end
local function perhapsStartRaids(now)
 for uid,state in pairs(sessions) do
  if not raids[uid] and state.Base and now>state.NextRaidAt and state.ShieldUntil<=now
   and (state.TotalEarned>=CONFIG.RaidThreshold or state.Rebirths>=1)
   and countCreatures(state)>0 then
   startRaid(state)
  end
 end
end

-- IA DE INIMIGOS: cada guardiao patrulha seu ninho e persegue QUEM CARREGA LOOT.
for _,g in ipairs(GUARDS:GetChildren()) do
 if g:IsA("Model") and g.PrimaryPart then
  guardians[g]={Origin=Vector3.new(g:GetAttribute("HomeX"),g:GetAttribute("HomeY"),g:GetAttribute("HomeZ")),Position=g.PrimaryPart.Position,LastHit=0}
 end
end
local nextAIMove=0
local nextCashTick=0
while true do
 local now=os.clock()
 if now>=nextCashTick then
  nextCashTick=now+1
  perhapsStartRaids(now)
  for _,s in pairs(sessions) do
   local rate=income(s)
   if rate>0 then
    s.Cash+=rate
    s.TotalEarned+=rate
   end
   syncState(s)
   if s.Base then
    local shield=s.ShieldUntil>now
    local owner=s.Player.DisplayName
    setSign(s.Base,owner..(shield and " • ESCUDO" or (s.TotalEarned>=CONFIG.RobberyThreshold or s.Rebirths>0) and " • ROUBAVEL" or " • INICIANTE"))
   end
  end
 end
 if now>=nextAIMove then
  local dt=math.min(.25, now-nextAIMove+.13)
  nextAIMove=now+.13
  stepRaids(dt,now)
  for guardian,data in pairs(guardians) do
   if guardian.Parent and guardian.PrimaryPart then
    local pos=data.Position
    local target=nil
    local nearest=85
    for _,s in pairs(sessions) do
     if s.Held and s.Held.Kind=="Egg" then
      local _,hum,hrp=goodChar(s.Player)
      if hrp then
       local d=(Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X,pos.Y,hrp.Position.Z)-pos).Magnitude
       if d<nearest and (hrp.Position-data.Origin).Magnitude<104 then
        target={Root=hrp,Humanoid=hum,Session=s}
        nearest=d
       end
      end
     end
    end
    local destination=target and Vector3.new(target.Root.Position.X,pos.Y,target.Root.Position.Z) or data.Origin
    if (destination-data.Origin).Magnitude>90 then
     target=nil destination=data.Origin
    end
    local horizontal=Vector3.new(destination.X-pos.X,0,destination.Z-pos.Z)
    local dist=horizontal.Magnitude
    if dist>.1 then
     local speed=guardian:GetAttribute("Speed") or 10
     local step=math.min(dist,speed*dt)
     local newpos=pos+(horizontal.Unit*step)
     data.Position=newpos
     guardian:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(newpos,Vector3.new(destination.X,newpos.Y,destination.Z)))
    end
    if target and nearest<6 and now-data.LastHit>=1.25 then
     if (target.Root.Position-data.Position).Magnitude<=6.5 then
      data.LastHit=now
      target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(guardian:GetAttribute("Power") or 10)
      toast(target.Session.Player,"Um guardiao te acertou! Fuja com o ovo!")
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 task.wait(.07)
end
